title: Unitree G1 29-DoF body contract for the SONIC deployment path

verification.method: read-only parsing of reference files (text, regex, ast, xml); no process launched, no DDS participant, no socket, no deployment runtime import
verification.statement: Nothing in this profile was observed at runtime or on hardware. Values are what the cited source configures; agreement labels compare sources, not reality.

references.note: Studio config/references.json records df53fd02...; this repository's HEAD has moved since that inventory
gear_sonic_deploy policy_parameters.hpp is identical to the runner copy apart from trailing whitespace
not a git repository; only DDS defaults and vendored unitree_rl_gym URDF mounts are cited

runner_cpp.used_by: SONIC C++ runner: values written into rt/lowcmd (kp/kd cast to float32), INIT ramp target and policy action offset/scale

flow_python.used_by: g1-student-deploy in-process lockstep PD (g1deploy/sonic.py pd_torque) and the Studio CPU worker control_contract export

training_isaaclab.used_by: SONIC policy training actuator model (IsaacLab G1_CYLINDER_MODEL_12_DEX_CFG)

mjcf_student_rubber.used_by: MuJoCo joint attributes of g1-student-deploy sim/assets/g1_29dof.xml (lockstep model, rubber hands)

mjcf_lucid_dex3.used_by: MuJoCo joint attributes of lucid sim/models/g1/g1_29dof_with_hand.xml (gear_sonic_sim scene_43dof, Dex3)

lucid_sim_torque_clip.used_by: explicit np.clip of PD torque in lucid gear_sonic_sim (base_sim.py:466, motor_effort_limit_list)

bundle_rev_1_0_contract.used_by: bundle/config/sonic_model_contract.json (g1_29dof_rev_1_0 MJCF); node.py clips streamed joint references to range_rad; actuatorfrcrange is recorded only

hands.used_by: g1-student-deploy lockstep (default) and the Studio CPU worker
lucid gear_sonic_sim scene_43dof (C++/DDS rehearsal); rehearse.py sets G1_BODY_MODEL=dex3 for the node's self filter

related.match: env.setdefault("G1_BODY_MODEL", "dex3")  # the rehearsal robot (lucid gear_sonic_sim) has Dex3 hands

model_variant.physical_variant_reason: LowState.mode_machine reports the robot type at runtime (the runner prints 'G1 type'); no capture of it was inspected. Hand type, torso revision and hip motor revision of the physical robot are unknown.

waist.summary: Waist roll (13) and pitch (14) are actuated, 2x5020 gains, range +-0.52 rad. robot_parameters.hpp marks them INVALID on 23-DoF and waist-locked 29-DoF units; the runner has no waist-lock branch and commands all 29 slots.

source.match: WaistRoll = 13, // NOTE INVALID for g1 23dof/29dof with waist locked

related.match: WaistPitch = 14, // NOTE INVALID for g1 23dof/29dof with waist locked

mode_pr.meaning: Mode::PR series pitch/roll ankle (and waist) control; AB = 1 parallel motors. The runner initializes and always writes PR.

source.match: PR = 0, ///< Series control for Pitch / Roll joints.

mode_machine.reason: echoed from LowState at runtime; 0 until a LowState arrives and 0 in gear_sonic_sim (never set by the bridge)

semantics.unitree_motor: LowCmd_.motor_cmd[i] / LowState_.motor_state[i] for i in 0..28 (slots 29..34 of the 35-element arrays are unused by the 29-DoF runner). Identical to the MuJoCo body-joint order.
semantics.mujoco: body hinge joints of g1_29dof.xml in document order; also the Dex3 models' body joints after removing the 14 hand joints (their qpos addresses differ: hand joints are interleaved after each arm).
semantics.isaaclab: breadth-first articulation order used by SONIC observations/actions, the ZMQ pose joint_pos/joint_vel arrays and runner-internal body_q/last_action.

mapping_arrays.naming_note: Same permutation, inverted names: contract.py ISAAC_TO_MJ == C++ mujoco_to_isaaclab == training G1_MUJOCO_TO_ISAACLAB_DOF (value = MuJoCo index of IsaacLab joint i); contract.py MJ_TO_ISAAC == C++ isaaclab_to_mujoco == training G1_ISAACLAB_TO_MUJOCO_DOF. Each file uses its own name consistently; never copy an array by name across files.

source.match: #: isaac_to_mj[i] = MuJoCo index of IsaacLab joint i
